sections.content: Use the pretérito perfecto with ya and todavía no to describe what has happened during the bike ride and what remains to happen. Keep the auxiliary and participle together, and place ya or todavía no before them.

items.english: We have already rented five bicycles.

items.spanish: Durante el camino ya hemos visto arrozales y templos.
items.english: During the ride we have already seen rice fields and temples.

items.spanish: Todavía no hemos navegado entre las montañas.
items.english: We have not travelled by boat between the mountains yet.

items.spanish: Ya hemos recorrido la zona en bicicleta.
items.english: We have already explored the area by bicycle.

sections.content: The two expressions create a useful contrast: ya describes completed progress; todavía no describes what remains to be done.
